notes.title: Update 0.13.0 - Adding Bots to Multiplayer Games
notes.content:
A new version of the game was released. Here’s all the changes:

Game Features

 Add Bots to Multiplayer Games
 Added French Translations (Special Thanks to our community member ErZ)
 Flexible Deploy Limit - Starts at 5, increases by 1 every 5 turns
 Stable Gold Price Inflation (Market)
 Add Science Progress and Military Score to End-game Scoring
 Add 'Industrialization' Technology (+50% Resource Production)
 Test removing Market Spread (difference between purchase/sell value)

Balancing

 Increase Income per Country from $25 to $30
 Increase Gold Price from $50 to $75
 Increase Price for Research Points from $110 to $130
 Increase Cost for "Gold Mine" (+3 Gold per Turn) from 5 to 6 Research Points
 Nerfed Science Point generating technologies: 

   +1 point costs 4 SP (3 before)
   +2 points costs 8 (6 before)
   +3 points costs 15 (12 before)
   The second tech where you'd get +2 points for 8 was removed => maximum production is now 8pts/turn (11 before)

 Increased Base Camp I deploy limit bonus from +1 to +5
 Increased Base Camp II deploy limit bonus from +2 to +10 and reduced SP cost from 8 to 5
 Increased Market Stock for Research Points from 50 to 80
 Increased Market Stock for Chips from 50 to 100
 Increased Market Stock for Steel from 200 to 250
 Turn Timer 'Standard Pace': Extra time per turn reduced from +10s to +5s

UX Improvements

 Added Deploy Limit Indicator to UI
 Speed up Unit Destroy Animations
 Instantly Hide "Skip Animations" Button after Click

Bugfixes

 Fixed bug where percentage-based resource bonuses were applied not only to countries' resource production but also to flat resource income (like Research Points)
 Fixed bug where some achievements triggered for observing (out of game) players
 Fixed bug where "Surrender game" triggered the "Win a game within 5 turns" achievement
 Fixed bug where Singleplayer game dialog was not localized fully

To play Border Clash and participate in our Beta, please join our Discord Community.

Free Demo coming soon!

Thank you for adding Border Clash to your WISHLIST!

notes.title: Update 0.9.5 - New Game Phase & No Movement Cost
notes.content:
A new minor version of the game was released. Here’s all the changes:

Game Mechanics

 Remove Movement Cost - Movement and Attacks do not cost anything anymore.
 Oil to build units - 1 Oil is now required for any unit to build
 4 Game Phases - Removing the cost attached to troop movement allowed for splitting up the turn phases into 4 distinct phases (vs. 3 before). and re-ordering them. 

The turn phases are now: 
"Deploy -> Attack -> Battle -> Build"

This allows for a much cleaner, faster and less complex game without losing any of the game's depth

Improvements

 The full Border Clash Wiki is now also integrated in interactive Help Pages within the game, access via (?)-Icon on top of the screen
 First turn deploy phase now has 3x the time so players can check out the map and think about strategy at the start of the game
 Change Timer Settings in Game Creation to "Time per Phase"
 Removed Timer for Single Player Mode
 Create View Toggle for Unit Display Mode
 Slight transparency for UI panel backgrounds
 Better Formatting for Country Pick Order Panel 
 New Scoring Strategy for Multiplayer Leaderboard - Progress Scoring Strategy now gives points for played games as well to reflect "experience" in the game

Bugfixes

 Fixed bug where Player Pick mode showed resources double


To play Border Clash and participate in our Closed Beta, please join our Discord Community.

notes.title: Update 0.9.0 - Balancing, UI and Smart Bots
notes.content:
A new major version of the game was released. Here’s all the changes:

Game Mechanics

Map

Removed Quebec-Great Britain connection

Income

Player Base Income - Add a $150 base income for any player and reduce influence based income from $2,5 per player and point to $2 per player and point

Smarter NPCs

NPC to not deploy in back country anymore
NPCs to sell excess resources
NPC to acquire and and defend regions (for region bonuses)
NPC to purchase high level units (tanks and jets)
Research preferences for NPC
NPC to move units from back country to the front
NPC to have personalities (NPC can have different preferences, strategies, levels of irrationality etc.)

Improved NPC Attacking

NPC to not always attack with all units
NPC to use Military Strength for evaluation (instead of number of units)
NPC attack evaluation to determine optimum number of troops to leave behind to defend
NPC to purchase oil for attacks
Improved budgeting for NPC command phase
Include science & research bonuses in NPC evaluation

Resource Balancing

Tank Cost increased to 12 steel (before 8 steel)
Jet cost changed to 5 steel, 4 components (before 8 steel, 3 components)
Map to provide less components (4 instead of 6)
Map to provide more gold (6 instead of 4)
Gold to inflate at 5% (before 6%)

Science Balancing

Gold Mines decreased to $80 per Turn (before $100 per turn)
Mining Carts decreased to +10 Steel per Turn (before +12 Steel per turn)
Debt Monetization decreased to +$300 per Turn (before +$400 per turn)
Level 2 Science Cost increased to $600 (before $500)
S12 Projectiles converts 15% of Hits to Double Hits (before 10%)
Unlock level 3 research at 6 technologies (8 before)
Unlock level 4 research at 9 technologies (12 before)

Market

Reduce market stock for higher price impact


Improvements

“Fast Resolve” - Skip all battle animations in Singleplayer mode to speed up game experience
Faster Camera Zoom
Country Summary View - Displays a countries resources and military strength when zoomed out (versus full unit details)
Zoom-Level adjusting UI
Highlight active battles instead of zooming in to create context for battles
Bind ‘Enter' key to confirm active dialogs


Bugfixes

Country pick mode not showing units & resources
Losing selected unit type in deploy phase when zooming
Quick purchase missing oil button does not update when selected units change
Level 4 research does not unlock even though player meets requirements of 12 techs
Unit count in deployment window has no background color in (MacOS) build


To play Border Clash and participate in our Closed Beta, please join our Discord Community.
